entities.summary: Charmion von Wiegand (1896–1983) was an American abstract painter, journalist, writer, collector, benefactor and art critic. She was the daughter of Inez Royce, an artist, and Karl Henry von Wiegand. Karl Henry von Wiegand was the German-born journalist known for wartime reporting.
